title: Processing history attached to each value separates conflicting evidence on metastable (Si)GeSn semiconductors
description: Code, data and figure scripts for the paper "Processing history attached to each value separates conflicting evidence on metastable (Si)GeSn semiconductors" (Semiconductor Science and Technology (IOP)). Taylor D. Sparks acknowledges support from the Army Research Office Materials Design, under Contract No. W911NF-23-1-0333.
notes: Code (Python, shell and SLURM scripts) is released under the MIT License (LICENSE). Archived third-party datasets keep their own terms; their sources are cited in the paper.
